notes: Estonian cadastre (Maa-amet). Land value only (maks_hind); no building value. Under ~40k parcels → raw GeoParquet path, no PMTiles. See docs/estonia-cadastre-glossary.md. Region grouping by linnaosa (city district). `district` (= ay_nimi) is a parcel property, so the region list is derived from the loaded parcels (no PMTiles metadata needed). Boundary outlines come from the official Maa-amet EHAK settlement-unit polygons (ehak:asustusyksuste_piirid); the overlay's `name` matches the cadastre district exactly.
